title: Annual General Meeting
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.96, s.101, s.102; Secretarial Standard SS-2

notice.text: To all the Members of {{ company_name }},
Notice is hereby given that the Annual General Meeting of the members of {{ company_name }} will be held on {{ meeting_date }} at {{ meeting_time }} at {{ venue }} to transact the following business:

items: To receive, consider and adopt the audited financial statements of the Company for the financial year ended {{ fy_label }}, together with the reports of the Board of Directors and the Auditors thereon.
To appoint a Director in place of the Director retiring by rotation.

notice.text: Notes: A member entitled to attend and vote is entitled to appoint a proxy to attend and vote instead of that member, and a proxy need not be a member. Proxy forms must be deposited at the registered office not less than forty-eight hours before the meeting.

{{ chairperson }} took the chair. The Chairperson informed the meeting that the requisite quorum was present and called the meeting to order.

attendance.text: Members and others present, as recorded below.

title: Appointment of Director
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.152, s.161; Rule 8 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Board Resolution — Appointment of Director

The Chairperson informed the Board that {{ appointee_name }} (DIN: {{ appointee_din }}) has consented to act as a Director of the Company and has furnished the declarations required under the Companies Act, 2013. After discussion, the Board passed the following resolution:

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Sections 152 and 161 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder, and the Articles of Association of the Company, {{ appointee_name }} (DIN: {{ appointee_din }}) be and is hereby appointed as {{ designation }} of the Company with effect from {{ appointment_date }}, subject to regularisation by the members at the next general meeting.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to file the necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies and to do all such acts as may be necessary to give effect to the above resolution.

notes_to_agenda.text: {{ appointee_name }} has submitted consent in Form DIR-2 and a declaration in Form DIR-8 confirming non-disqualification under Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013. Form DIR-12 is required to be filed with the Registrar within thirty days of the appointment.

letter.text: Letter of Appointment
To,
{{ appointee_name }}
Dear {{ appointee_name }},

We are pleased to inform you that the Board of Directors of {{ company_name }}, at its meeting held on {{ appointment_date }}, appointed you as {{ designation }} of the Company with effect from that date.
Your appointment is subject to the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Articles of Association of the Company.
We look forward to the benefit of your guidance.
For {{ company_name }}

title: Resignation of Director
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.168; Rule 15 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Board Resolution — Resignation of Director

The Chairperson placed before the Board the letter of resignation dated {{ letter_date }} received from {{ director_name }} (DIN: {{ director_din }}). The Board took note of the resignation and passed the following resolution:

RESOLVED THAT the resignation of {{ director_name }} (DIN: {{ director_din }}) from the office of Director of the Company, tendered by letter dated {{ letter_date }}, be and is hereby taken note of and accepted with effect from {{ resignation_date }} pursuant to Section 168 of the Companies Act, 2013.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to file Form DIR-12 with the Registrar of Companies and to make the consequential entries in the Register of Directors and Key Managerial Personnel.

notes_to_agenda.text: Under Section 168 of the Companies Act, 2013 the resignation takes effect from the date the notice is received by the Company or any later date specified in the notice. Form DIR-12 must be filed within thirty days. The resigning Director may also file Form DIR-11 in their own capacity.

title: Appointment of Statutory Auditor
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.139; Rule 4 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Ordinary Resolution — Appointment of Statutory Auditor

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Section 139 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder, {{ auditor_name }}, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. {{ auditor_frn }}), be and are hereby appointed as the Statutory Auditors of the Company to hold office from the conclusion of this Annual General Meeting until the conclusion of the Annual General Meeting to be held for the financial year {{ term_to_fy }}, at such remuneration as may be determined by the Board of Directors.
{{ auditor_name }} have furnished a certificate confirming their eligibility and that their appointment, if made, would be within the limits prescribed under the Act.

notes_to_agenda.text: The appointment is for the term from financial year {{ term_from_fy }} to {{ term_to_fy }}. Form ADT-1 must be filed with the Registrar within fifteen days of the meeting at which the appointment was made ({{ agm_date }}).

title: Change of Registered Office
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.12(4); Rule 27 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Board Resolution — Change of Registered Office

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 12 of the Companies Act, 2013, the registered office of the Company be and is hereby shifted from {{ registered_office }} to {{ new_address }} with effect from {{ effective_date }}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to file Form INC-22 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days and to take all steps necessary to give effect to this resolution.

notes_to_agenda.text: A change of registered office within the same city, town or village requires only a Board resolution. A change outside local limits requires a special resolution, and a change between the jurisdictions of two Registrars requires the approval of the Regional Director.

title: Declaration of Dividend
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.123, s.124; the Companies (Declaration and Payment of Dividend) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Resolution — Declaration of {{ dividend_type }} Dividend

The Board considered the profits available for distribution for the financial year {{ fy_label }} and, being satisfied that the dividend is proposed out of profits determined in accordance with Section 123 of the Companies Act, 2013, passed the following resolution:

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 123 of the Companies Act, 2013, a {{ dividend_type }} dividend of {{ rate_per_share }} per equity share, aggregating {{ total_amount }}, be and is hereby declared for the financial year {{ fy_label }}, payable to the members whose names appear on the Register of Members as on {{ record_date }}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the dividend so declared be paid within thirty days of the declaration and that any unpaid or unclaimed amount be transferred to a separate bank account in accordance with Section 124 of the Companies Act, 2013.

notes_to_agenda.text: Dividend may be declared only out of profits of the current or previous financial years, or out of both, after providing for depreciation. An interim dividend is declared by the Board; a final dividend is declared by the members at the Annual General Meeting on the Board's recommendation. Unpaid amounts must be moved to a separate account within seven days of the thirty-day payment window.

title: Appointment of Key Managerial Personnel
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.203; Rule 8 of the Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Board Resolution — Appointment of {{ kmp_designation }}

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder, {{ appointee_name }} be and is hereby appointed as the {{ kmp_designation }} of the Company, being a whole-time Key Managerial Personnel, with effect from {{ appointment_date }} on the terms and conditions including remuneration of {{ remuneration }} as placed before the Board.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to file the necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies and to do all such acts as may be necessary to give effect to this resolution.

notes_to_agenda.text: A whole-time Key Managerial Personnel may not hold office in more than one company at the same time, except in a subsidiary, and shall be appointed by a Board resolution containing the terms of appointment including remuneration.

title: Registration of Share Transfer (SH-4)
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.56, s.46; the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014 r.11

resolution.text: Resolution - Registration of Transfer of Shares

The Board considered the instrument of transfer in Form SH-4 dated {{ instrument_date }} lodged by {{ transferor_name }} together with the relevant share certificate, and noted that the instrument was duly stamped, dated and executed by or on behalf of the transferor and the transferee.

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 56 of the Companies Act, 2013 and Rule 11 of the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014, the transfer of {{ no_of_shares }} {{ share_class }} shares of the Company bearing distinctive numbers {{ distinctive_from }} to {{ distinctive_to }} from {{ transferor_name }} to {{ transferee_name }} for a consideration of {{ consideration }} be and is hereby approved and registered, and that the name of the transferee be entered in the Register of Members accordingly.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the share certificate lodged with the instrument be cancelled and that a fresh share certificate be issued to the transferee under the seal or signature of the authorised signatories of the Company within one month of the date of this resolution, and that the Register of Members and the Register of Transfers be updated accordingly.

notes_to_agenda.text: A company shall not register a transfer of shares unless a proper instrument of transfer in Form SH-4, duly stamped, dated and executed by or on behalf of both the transferor and the transferee, has been delivered to the company within sixty days of execution, along with the certificate relating to the shares.

Stamp duty is payable at 0.25% of the consideration under Article 62(a) of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899. The certificate for the transferred shares must be delivered within one month of the date of registration of the transfer.

minutes_narration.text: The Chairperson placed before the Board the instrument of transfer in Form SH-4 dated {{ instrument_date }} in respect of {{ no_of_shares }} {{ share_class }} shares bearing distinctive numbers {{ distinctive_from }} to {{ distinctive_to }}, transferred by {{ transferor_name }} to {{ transferee_name }}. The Board examined the instrument, found it in order, and approved the transfer.

title: Right Issue of Shares
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.62(1)(a); the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014

resolution.text: Resolution - Issue of Shares on a Rights Basis

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 62(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder, the Company do offer {{ shares_offered }} equity shares of face value {{ face_value }} each at a price of {{ price_per_share }} per share to the existing members of the Company in the ratio of {{ ratio }}, to those whose names appear in the Register of Members as on {{ record_date }}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the letter of offer specify that the offer is open from {{ offer_open }} to {{ offer_close }}, that it includes a right to renounce the shares offered in favour of any other person, and that if the offer is not accepted within that period it shall be deemed to have been declined.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any Director or the Company Secretary be and is hereby authorised to despatch the letter of offer, to allot the shares subscribed for, to issue the share certificates and to file Form PAS-3 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days of allotment.

notes_to_agenda.text: A rights offer under Section 62(1)(a) must be made to existing members in proportion to their holdings, must be open for not less than fifteen days and not more than thirty days from despatch, and must carry the right of renunciation unless the articles provide otherwise. Return of allotment in Form PAS-3 is due within thirty days of allotment.

title: Private Placement / Preferential Allotment
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.42, s.62(1)(c); the Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules, 2014 r.14

resolution.text: Resolution - Private Placement of Shares

The Board noted the valuation report of the registered valuer bearing reference {{ valuation_ref }} and the special resolution of the members passed on {{ special_resolution_date }} authorising the offer.

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Sections 42 and 62(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 14 of the Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules, 2014, the Company do offer {{ shares_offered }} equity shares of face value {{ face_value }} each at a price of {{ price_per_share }} per share, determined on the basis of the said valuation report, to the {{ allottee_count }} identified persons whose names are recorded in the private placement offer letter in Form PAS-4.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the application money be received only by cheque, demand draft or other banking channel and be kept in a separate bank account, that no allotment be made until the money is so received, and that the return of allotment in Form PAS-3 be filed within fifteen days of allotment.

notes_to_agenda.text: A private placement offer may be made to not more than two hundred identified persons in a financial year, excluding qualified institutional buyers and employees under a scheme of employees stock option. Application money must not be received in cash, and utilisation is barred until the return of allotment is filed.

title: Grant of Employee Stock Options
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.62(1)(b); the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014 r.12

resolution.text: Resolution - Grant of Options under {{ scheme_name }}

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 62(1)(b) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 12 of the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014 and the {{ scheme_name }} approved by the members, {{ options_granted }} employee stock options be and are hereby granted with effect from {{ grant_date }} to the {{ grantee_count }} eligible employees named in the annexure to these minutes, at an exercise price of {{ exercise_price }} per option.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the options shall vest over {{ vesting_period }} from the date of grant, that there shall be a minimum period of one year between grant and vesting, that the options shall not be transferable, pledged or otherwise encumbered, and that the Company Secretary be authorised to maintain the Register of Employee Stock Options in Form SH-6 at the registered office.

notes_to_agenda.text: A minimum of one year must elapse between the grant of options and their vesting. Options are not transferable and carry no right to dividend or to vote until the shares are issued on exercise. The Register of Employee Stock Options in Form SH-6 must be maintained at the registered office.

title: Loan, Guarantee, Security or Investment (s.186)
source_ref: Companies Act, 2013 s.186; the Companies (Meetings of Board and its Powers) Rules, 2014 r.11, r.13

variables.name: special_resolution_date
variables.label: Special resolution, if the ceiling is exceeded

resolution.text: Resolution - {{ entry_type }} under Section 186
The Board considered the proposal and noted the position of the Company against the ceiling prescribed by Section 186(2): {{ within_limit }}.

RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013, and with the consent of all the Directors present at the meeting, the Company do provide a {{ entry_type }} of {{ amount }} to {{ party_name }} for the purpose of {{ purpose }}, carrying interest at {{ rate_of_interest }}, on such terms as the Board may consider appropriate.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the particulars of this transaction be entered in the register maintained under Section 186(9) in Form MBP-2 within seven days, that the register be kept at the registered office and be open to inspection by members, and that Form MGT-14 be filed with the Registrar of Companies where required.

notes_to_agenda.text: Section 186(2) caps loans, guarantees, securities and investments at the higher of sixty per cent of paid-up share capital, free reserves and securities premium, or one hundred per cent of free reserves and securities premium. The cap may be exceeded only with the prior authority of a special resolution passed in general meeting.

The resolution requires the consent of all the directors present at the meeting, and, where the company has a term loan outstanding, the prior approval of the public financial institution. Loans to a wholly owned subsidiary are exempt from the ceiling under Section 186(11), but the register entry is still required.
